documentation: Key/value backend for `mhl serve mcp --http` durable state (sessions + run checkpoints + owners), stored one row per key in a PostgreSQL table `(key text primary key, value jsonb, updated_at timestamptz)`. `put` is an atomic INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE.

properties.name: dsn
properties.documentation: Full connection string (URL `postgres://user:pass@host:port/db?sslmode=...` or libpq keyword/value). Wins over the discrete fields. Use env("DATABASE_URL").

properties.name: host
properties.documentation: Database host (used when `dsn` is not set).

properties.name: password
properties.documentation: Role password. Use env("PGPASSWORD"); the host resolves and redacts it.

properties.name: sslmode
properties.documentation: libpq sslmode: disable | prefer (default) | require | verify-ca | verify-full.

properties.name: table
properties.documentation: Target table. Default "mhl_store". May be schema-qualified ("schema.table"). Identifier characters only.

properties.name: prefix
properties.documentation: Optional key namespace within the table (stored/stripped transparently). Default "" — the table already isolates state.

properties.name: statement_timeout
properties.documentation: Per-statement server-side timeout as a Go duration ("10s", "500ms"). Unset = server default.

properties.name: auto_migrate
properties.documentation: Run CREATE TABLE / CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS on first use. Default true. Set false when the schema is managed externally.

properties.name: log
properties.documentation: Optional path to append a JSON-lines wire trace (one line per handled message) for debugging.

methods.name: get
methods.documentation: The value at key, or null when no row.

methods.name: put
methods.documentation: Upsert value at key (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE).

methods.name: delete
methods.documentation: Delete the row. An absent key is not an error.

methods.name: list
methods.documentation: Every key with the given prefix (indexed key LIKE prefix || '%', ordered).
